_comment: Shopping bulk pipeline catalog (npm run shopping:bulk). One entry per category: `key` is permanent (checkpoints, reports). `platforms` = Priority-1 sites that sell it. A platform with a category page for `categoryKey` (src/config/sites.ts) browses it; the others search `category`. `count` = products per platform per run. broadCategory/subCategory must exist in src/config/taxonomy.ts. Set enabled:false to pause.
